verdict.rationale: Helicone's prompt management lets you track every change, compare versions, and roll back instantly, and prompts are deployed by ID without redeploying the app. That covers version, review, and rollback for prompts, the closest thing to an automation artifact here. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning or rollback for its actual automation surfaces (webhooks, alerts, routing/fallback configs), and the claims are first-party docs only. Missing for 10: versioning/rollback of webhooks, alerts, and gateway routing configs; a documented review/approval workflow beyond version comparison; independent or hands-on corroboration.
